founder.name: Dheeraj A
founder.biography: Dheeraj A is the founder of CreativeXCreations. He built the site as a home for his video-editing portfolio and services, spanning creator-focused social videos, documentary pieces, motion graphics, and cinematic showcases. The work presented here emphasizes clear storytelling, deliberate pacing, polished visuals, and platform-ready delivery. His stated focus is helping creators present ideas with stronger visual structure and audience retention.

about.title: Premium editing with brand-first storytelling.
about.paragraph1: CreativeXCreations specializes in cinematic edits for creators who want a premium, results-driven look. We pair strategic pacing, motion design, and platform insight with studio-level polish.
about.paragraph2: Whether you need short-form reels, documentary-style content, or cinematic brand films, we build each project for watch-through, replay value, and emotional impact.
about.summaryTitle: Designed to feel premium and performance-ready.
about.summaryText: We help creators convert attention into action, using cinematic motion, meaningful captions, and fast technical delivery.
about.workflowText: Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, and CapCut, with consistent creative direction.
about.deliveryText: Fast previews, clear revision rounds, and final export packages optimized for platforms and timelines.
